messages:
Ari: Need a compact launch pack for the three landing pages (Hosted API / Dedicated / Private) + routing rules for inbound forms. Can we close this today?
Ben: Ill draft Hosted API headlines + two proof lines. Short CTA: 'Get started (free credits)'.
Clara: Ill handle Dedicated + Private bullets. Dedicated = SLA + throughput; Private = compliance + networking. Keep bullets 3-5 words.
Diego: Ops will implement form slugs and routing. Suggest slugs: deployment_choice, lead_intent, company_size. Where should demo leads go?
Ari: Routing priority: demo -> sales-demo (instant slack); enterprise -> sales-enterprise + ops tag; technical -> devx (daily digest); webinar -> growth automation. Private+enterprise -> high-priority ops tag.
Ben: Hosted draft: "Hosted inference, ready for production." Proof: "p50 ~100ms (sample)", "Free credits + SDKs". CTA alt: "View docs"
Clara: Dedicated bullets: "Reserved GPU pools", "Throughput SLAs", "Burstable capacity". Benchmark note: "sample results: 150 QPS, p95 220ms on common configs." Private bullets: "VPC/on-prem", "KMS integrations", "Audit logs & SOC2-ready"
Diego: Will wire rules as: if lead_intent==demo -> sales-demo + slack:#sales; if enterprise -> sales-enterprise + tag:enterprise_ops; if technical -> devx-queue (batch); if webinar -> growth-rsvp. Ill post webhook payload example once staged.
notif-bot: Routing rules deployed to staging (job 6710) :white_check_mark:
Ari: Action items: Ben finish Hosted copy (2pm), Clara finish Dedicated/Private bullets (2pm), Diego post webhook sample (4pm). Ill assemble assets and push to /marketing-assets when ready. React with :thumbsup: when done.
